summary: Constructs a 4x4 diagonal scale matrix over eight qword slots in a1 from three integer inputs (a2, a3, a4) using 3DNow! intrinsics: a2 becomes the low dword of slot 0, a3 is shifted left 32 bits into the high dword of slot 2, a4 becomes the low dword of slot 5, slot 7 carries the homogeneous 1.0 constant, and slots 1, 3, 4, 6 are zeroed.

local_names.a1: output matrix base, eight __m64 qword slots
local_names.a2: scale component stored in slot 0 low dword
local_names.a3: scale component stored shifted into slot 2 high dword
local_names.a4: scale component stored in slot 5 low dword

operations.description: Emit 3DNow! femms to flush the MMX state around the pack stores
Store a2 as the low dword of slot 0 at offset 0
Shift a3 left 32 bits to place it in the high dword of slot 2
Store the shifted a3 into slot 2 at offset 16
Store a4 as the low dword of slot 5 at offset 40
Store the homogeneous 1.0 qword constant into slot 7 at offset 56
Return the output matrix base a1
